parts.covers: Recorded units sold and revenue for MILK-FC-500ML on each June day, to compare against the negative book-stock dates.
parts.sql: select "daily-sales-june"."date" as "date", sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "units_sold", sum("daily-sales-june"."revenue_inr") as "revenue_inr" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) group by "daily-sales-june"."date" order by "date" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'MILK-FC-500ML'; group by daily sales.date; report date = daily sales.date, units_sold = sum of daily sales.units_sold, revenue_inr = sum of daily sales.revenue_inr; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: Shelf audits are 11:00 snapshots twice a week, not hours off the shelf; no audit time or shift is recorded, so morning vs evening cannot be determined from records.
parts.sql: select cast(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",12,2) as integer) as "hour", count(*) as "stockouts" from "shelf-audits-june"  where (("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts" >= ?) AND ("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts" < ?)) and ("shelf-audits-june"."status" = ?) group by cast(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",12,2) as integer) order by "stockouts" desc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where (shelf audits.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01T00:00:00' and shelf audits.audit_ts < '2026-07-01T00:00:00') and shelf audits.status = 'empty'; group by hour(shelf audits.audit_ts); report hour = hour(shelf audits.audit_ts), stockouts = count of *; sorted by stockouts desc.

parts.covers: On-time check: arrival between slot_start and slot_end for each June delivery.
parts.sql: select "shipments-june"."shipment_id" as "shipment_id", "shipments-june"."arrived_ts" as "arrived_ts", "shipments-june"."slot_start" as "slot_start", "shipments-june"."slot_end" as "slot_end" from "shipments-june"  where (("shipments-june"."arrived_ts" < "shipments-june"."slot_end") AND ("shipments-june"."arrived_ts" > "shipments-june"."slot_start")) and ("shipments-june"."shipment_id" is not null) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shipment records; keep rows where (shipments.arrived_ts < shipments.slot_end and shipments.arrived_ts > shipments.slot_start) and shipments.shipment_id is not empty; report shipment_id = shipments.shipment_id, arrived_ts = shipments.arrived_ts, slot_start = shipments.slot_start, slot_end = shipments.slot_end.
